usedFor: WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta) receives customer messages, and HubSpot opens a deal through “Create Deal” for each “Message Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “Message Notification” in WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta), then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An inbound message becomes a deal right away, so a sales enquiry is not buried in a chat.

watchOut: Every received message fires “Message Notification”, so one chat can open many deals unless you filter first.
